title: Guava: Distilling Frontier VLMs into a Compact Agent through a Robotic Manipulation Harness
abstract: arXiv:2606.18363v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. translated_title: Guava：通过机器人操作框架将前沿视觉语言模型蒸馏为紧凑的具身智能体
translated_abstract: 在大规模视觉-语言数据上训练的语言模型已经展现出作为具身智能体的强大潜力。通过具身工具使用来驾驭模型，将高层推理与外部的感知、规划和控制模块相结合，为端到端的视觉-语言-动作系统提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，目前尚不清楚什么样的框架对于具身操作是有效的，以及这样的框架能在多大程度上释放各类推理模型的具身能力。在本工作中，我们提出了Guava——一个用于具身工具使用的框架，它是在对智能体工作流、动作空间和观察空间设计空间的系统性探索中开发而成的。我们的研究识别出了有效具身智能体的三个关键要素：迭代的感知-推理-动作循环、语义化的动作抽象，以及多模态观察。为了理解这些设计原则是否（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Guava通过对智能体工作流、动作空间和观察空间的系统性探索，发现了有效具身智能体的三大关键要素——迭代感知-推理-动作循环、语义动作抽象和多模态观察，并以此构建了将前沿视觉语言模型蒸馏为紧凑具身操作智能体的机器人操作框架。
en_tdlr: Guava is a robotic manipulation harness framework that systematically explores agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces, identifying three key ingredients—iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations—for distilling frontier VLMs into compact embodied manipulation agents.
